rules: Fade active tab content using opacity only, 90ms ease-out.
Fade windows 70ms, menus 110ms, and tooltips 100ms on show.
Transition button, tab, and editable-field paint properties for 120ms ease-out.
Keep pressed and focus feedback immediate.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion for all CSS transitions and fades.

overrideContract.reduceMotion: Disable native tree animation when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.

scope: Exact hash-bound motion assets; no general runtime override or geometry permission.
